# Better questions for everyday decisions.

Prices at the store. Electricity at home. A fantasy lineup. Where to learn.
This is a journal for looking at ordinary choices through data, one careful
question at a time.

[Explore the projects](#projects){.primary-link}

::: {.status-note}
**A starting point, not a record of finished work.** Entries appear only after
the analysis and its evidence have been reviewed.
:::

:::

## Four questions to explore {#projects}

::: {.project-index}

### [What do grocery prices show?](projects/groceries.qmd)

Bread, eggs and milk in a fixed historical price vintage.

### [How is electricity used at home?](projects/electricity.qmd)

Minute-by-minute measurements from one household, not an electricity bill.

### [What can a fantasy matchup tell us?](projects/fantasy.qmd)

Projections, outcomes and the gaps that limit a comparison.

### [What can learning data actually tell us?](projects/learning.qmd)

Course and assessment records, with privacy and context in view.

:::
